team_facets.when: The requested deliverable is a spreadsheet or connected workbook with formulas.

assignments.contribution: Own formula semantics, recalculation and preservation of workbook features.

team_facets.when: The task creates or substantially revises API/repository documentation or technical explanation.

assignments.contribution: Trace claims and runnable examples to the owning implementation.

team_facets.when: The task needs a consequential structural boundary or architecture review.

assignments.contribution: Trace ownership, affected consumers and migration cost before choosing a boundary.
Resolve interfaces, technical obligations and integration sequence.

team_facets.when: The task spans interdependent workstreams with uncertain sequencing or ownership.

assignments.contribution: Own dependency readiness, observable milestones and resumption state.

team_facets.when: The decision concerns company-wide allocation, concentration or strategic direction.

assignments.contribution: Own opportunity cost, capacity, economics and reversal thresholds.

team_facets.when: The task creates a new project/package or runnable scaffold.

assignments.contribution: Establish the first reproducible slice with the chosen toolchain.

team_facets.when: The task diagnoses or repairs a workstation, network or existing service path.

assignments.contribution: Isolate the failing layer and verify the affected user path after repair.

team_facets.when: The task requires a source-grounded synthesis of uncertain external facts.

assignments.contribution: Own claim/source applicability, contradictions, provenance and coverage limits.

workflows.when: Read, research or synthesize supplied project evidence without changing source.
workflows.rule: Use supplied evidence. Report missing retrieval or account access; this workflow has no shell, browser, source mutation or external messaging tool.

workflows.when: One schema-bound mechanical conversion with no filesystem effects.
workflows.rule: Use the declared deterministic operation and input as data. A compound or ambiguous objective must resolve upward; no tools are available in this workflow.

workflows.when: Implement source changes with exact artifact readback.
workflows.rule: Write only assigned project files and read back each changed artifact. Return awaiting_host_verification; the host must run declared build/tests and report current evidence through verification_handoff. No shell, dependency installation, commit, deployment or external effects are granted.

workflows.when: Review source, architecture or security and return findings without editing files.
workflows.rule: Return evidence-linked findings. Source mutation and design rendering are unavailable; add a separately justified deliverable if actual production is required.

workflows.when: Inspect existing artwork, screenshots or UI; critique visual quality and compare pixels.
workflows.rule: Inspect actual pixels against the brief and multiple relevant references, never similarity to one example alone. Locate defects in concept, composition, construction, coherence and placement fit; distinguish taste from correctness. Pixel diffs do not grade appeal. Captures and diff artifacts are permitted; source and canvas mutations are absent.

workflows.when: Author HTML/CSS screens or graphics requiring full DOM features such as Grid, filters or Canvas.
workflows.rule: Use Playwright for Grid, filters, Canvas/WebGL and live DOM. Inspect at verified 2x scale; a static-card renderer cannot replace DOM verification.

workflows.when: Produce or export a layered editable Penpot canvas through its official connected plugin.
workflows.rule: Use the official Penpot plugin connection. Opaque canvas edits require target-linked exported evidence and external inspection; never substitute a flat screenshot for an editable design.

workflows.when: Produce a Flexbox static card, badge, social graphic or data card.
workflows.rule: Use Satori/resvg for text/image composition with canonical tokens and supported fonts/Flexbox. Create image layers with a suitable available producer first; this renderer is not an image generator. Inspect hierarchy, crop, typography and brand fit at placement size and revise visible defects. Use web-interface for full DOM features; compose both only for distinct deliverables.

workflows.when: Produce flow, sequence, C4, Vega-Lite or Excalidraw diagram layouts.
workflows.rule: Use Kroki declarative layouts and the built-in SVGO/Playwright QA. Never replace graph layout with hand-positioned SVG coordinates.

workflows.when: Produce finite encoded video from an authored HTML/CSS/SVG timeline.
workflows.rule: Use HyperFrames lint, snapshot and render in order. Inspect saved keyframes; a successful encoder alone cannot establish composition quality.

workflows.when: Author and verify interactive UI animations, navigation transitions, animated SVG or browser scene choreography.
workflows.rule: Use browser_screenshot with bounded actions, CSS/WAAPI time samples or an authored __mirketSeek hook, and reduced-motion checks. For requested subject animation, verify its moving parts in a subject-only playback crop; background effects and whole-image entrances cannot establish internal articulation. Inspect saved states; do not claim playback smoothness from a seek. Use motion/HyperFrames only for encoded video.

workflows.when: Produce multi-page PDFs, print reports, invoices or presentation decks.
workflows.rule: Use Typst for paged output. Inspect every saved page; Playwright is QA support rather than an alternative PDF authoring pipeline.

workflows.when: Create editable SVG illustrations, icons and vector scene compositions.
workflows.rule: Choose SVG for requested vector editability or suitable geometric artwork, never as a silent fallback for rich raster illustration. Author meaningful geometry and semantic groups; compile tokens, render with vector_render, read back source and inspect pixels. Critique the visual idea and construction against the brief; revise material defects. An inspected render alone is not quality acceptance.

workflows.when: Resize, crop, convert or compress an existing raster.
workflows.rule: Use Sharp before compositing. Inspect output dimensions and focal crop; generation and general-purpose code execution are unavailable.

workflows.when: Optimize an existing SVG and verify its rendered appearance.
workflows.rule: Use SVGO for SVG hygiene and Playwright for its rendered comparison. Do not treat an optimized path or hash as visual equivalence.

workflows.when: Mechanically compare existing rendered screenshots or frames.
workflows.rule: Use Odiff against comparable pixels. A mismatch is a failed verification gate; add visual-review when interpretation or refinement is required.

workflows.when: Compile canonical DTCG design tokens into the five supported target formats.
workflows.rule: Style Dictionary is the token source of truth. Read back all generated formats before rendering; a role cannot override canonical token routing.
